Abhinav Deswal — Advocate (2023).

The scales of justice are the most expected symbol an advocate can use — so the brief was to make them personal. The interlocked A·D monogram becomes the upright the scales hang from: the advocate's own initials are what hold the balance.

Reduced on its own, the A·D ligature stands as a confident serif monogram — and because the construction is systematic, it extends cleanly to a second advocate's name with no redrawing.

Brand identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·74.
